text_block_list.text:
"To ensure victory in the final crown, the 
Shuka Sho, Vivlos decided to take on the 
Shion Stakes after summer training camp."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Umamusume who perform well in the ‘Shion 
Stakes’ often shine in the ‘Shuka Sho’ as 
well. I'll use that race to test my 
current strength—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
If I can do my best here, then the Shuka 
Sho will surely...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
choice_data_list:
You've grown so much—you'll be just fine 
now.

With how much you've grown, you'll be just 
fine.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I worked really hard at the 
training camp, after all!
